reason: Native Reader can reconstruct the confirmed SCM hierarchy and world matrices, but correct stage-object placement is still not empirically reproduced. Existing reverse evidence closes serialized positions and node world propagation separately, while the object/node attachment -> per-object render transform -> MDL_GLOBAL_MAT -> stage vertex-position chain is not yet closed end-to-end.
do_not_assume: Do not assume serialized SCM positions are final world-space positions.
Do not assume every SCM vertex must be CPU-transformed by objectBindingByNodeIndex world matrix until the EXE draw path proves it.
Do not assume SCM manager root/base matrix +0x1B0 is identity without SCM-provenanced producer evidence.
Do not infer geometry transform semantics from the header +0x13 lighting-reference world-matrix consumer; that path is lighting-specific.
Do not treat writer/reintegration success as original-game spatial-render acceptance.
already_confirmed: 0x1402FA360 builds SCM local transforms using XYZ radians and serialized translation.
0x1402F9700 propagates world matrices as local * parentOrRootWorld.
0x1402FAB70 independently establishes the MDL_GLOBAL_MAT constant block at +0x200/+0x240.
0x140300740 dispatches SCM pass 4 to per-object command builders 0x140300150 or 0x140305440.
0x14030A705 emits the active 0x5B00001C mesh descriptor used by the HD backend compatibility path.

priority_windows.purpose: Recover 0x1402FAB70 completely. Identify every input pointer/value used to build MDL_GLOBAL_MAT at constant-buffer +0x200/+0x240. Prove whether the source is manager root/base, scene-node world, per-object runtime matrix, camera/view state, or a composition. Enumerate direct callers and SCM-provenanced call sites.

Trace CDrawSCM object/mesh iteration into the 0x1402FAB70 global-matrix producer. Record the exact runtime object pointer, node/attachment index if present, matrix pointer, and branch conditions for each draw. Keep the known header+0x13 lighting-reference lookup separate from geometry placement.

From SCM setup, census all writes/initializers feeding manager+0x1B0 root/base matrix before 0x1402F9700. Prove whether canonical stage SCM receives identity, a stage/game transform, or another runtime matrix. Follow callers/xrefs beyond this acquisition window when the producer is external.

Recover the SCM-specific consumption of the third scene array during 0x1402FA360 initialization. Identify the runtime field written from objectBindingByNodeIndex and follow all later reads of that field into update/culling/queue/draw code. The closure target is a typed path from serialized object binding to the matrix used for the matching geometry object.

Trace per-object pass-4 command construction for manager+0xE0 bit1 clear. Record all object/node/matrix references copied into queue records and determine whether a transform selector or matrix pointer is encoded before queue drain.
Trace the alternate per-object pass-4 command construction for manager+0xE0 bit1 set. Record transform-bearing state and compare field-for-field with 0x140300150.
Follow queue entries from 0x140300150 to their executor. Identify where current object/mesh state becomes CDrawSCM/global-matrix input.
Follow queue entries from 0x140305440 to their executor. Compare matrix/object state with the sibling drain and locate convergence before draw submission.

Decode all 0x1C dwords of the 0x5B00001C mesh descriptor emitted at 0x14030A705. Determine whether any field carries object transform identity, matrix address/index, vertex base, or per-draw constant-state selector rather than only input-layout/material state.
Track the 0x5B mesh descriptor through the converter and isolate fields forwarded toward render/input selection versus constant-buffer state.

Map every write into the SCM constant-buffer region around +0x200..+0x2FF. Distinguish MDL_GLOBAL_MAT at +0x200/+0x240 from MDL_LIGHT_MAT at +0x280 and prove upload order/lifetime for one geometry object.

From the confirmed stage VS table selection, bind the selected DMC3_STG vertex variant to the embedded HLSL/compiled ABI and recover the exact POSITION transform formula consuming MDL_GLOBAL_MAT. Determine whether input POSITION is expected in object-local, scene-local, stage-world, or already transformed space. Follow to VSSetShader 0x14004C340.

required_closure_proofs: serialized object index -> scene attachment node or explicit proof that geometry does not use that binding
attachment/current-object state -> exact matrix input of 0x1402FAB70
SCM root/base matrix producer and value domain
DMC3_STG vertex POSITION -> exact MDL_GLOBAL_MAT multiplication formula
one complete object draw traced from serialized SCM position bytes to final vertex-shader input/output space

native_reader_acceptance.current_behavior: SCM adapter calls build_world_matrices(scene) with identity root_base, maps each geometry object to its bound node, and scene_projection CPU-transforms every serialized vertex by node.world.
required_ab_tests: raw serialized positions with no node transform
confirmed hierarchical node world with identity root
confirmed hierarchical node world with EXE-proven SCM root/base
native_reader_acceptance.rule: Do not promote a Native Reader placement fix solely because one stage looks plausible; require st001/st002 plus a multi-SCM corpus regression and evidence-linked matrix policy.
